style.styleTitle: Everlands 183cm Pinecone And Berry Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Introduce a beautifully natural, woodland feel to your home with the Everlands 183cm Pinecone &amp; Berry Christmas Garland. Designed with highly realistic PE needles that will not shed, this lush green garland is richly decorated with lifelike pine cones, green leaves, and contrasting white berries. Its flexible branches make it incredibly easy to shape and drape elegantly across your mantelpiece, staircase railing, or dining table.</p><p><strong>Key Features:</strong></p><ul><li>Dimensions: Approx. 183cm (Length) x 13cm (Width) x 18cm (Height)</li><li>Material: Made of low-maintenance, shape-retaining PE needles in a classic green colour</li><li>Details: Beautifully decorated with pine cones, green leaves, and white berries</li><li>Design: Highly flexible branches for easy styling</li><li>Use: Designed for indoor use</li></ul>
